import json, subprocess, tomllib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/rpuser1/Isaac-Sim-to-Real')
manifest=[]
for p in sorted((root/'workspace/tasks').glob('*/task.toml')):
    if p.parent.name.startswith('_'): continue
    data=tomllib.loads(p.read_text())
    for variant in data['task']['variants']:
        manifest.append((p.parent.name,variant,'so101'))
manifest.append(('pick_place_cube','teleop','sp7'))
for task,variant,arm in manifest:
    label=f'v3_env_{arm}_{task}_{variant}'
    command=f'docker exec -e S2R_ARM={arm} -e S2R_SCENE=rpd_meeting_room -e S2R_TASK={task} s2r-sim s2r-entrypoint python /tmp/v3_env_probe.py --task {task} --variant {variant} --arm {arm} --out /workspace/s2r/outputs/v3-sim-checks/v3/env_cfg/{arm}__{task}__{variant}.json'
    subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/v3-sim-checks/run.py',label,command])

from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/v3-sim-checks')
phase=sys.argv[1]
commit=sys.argv[2]
for name,task in [('scripted','pick_place_cube'),('stack_two_cubes','stack_two_cubes'),('stack_bowls','stack_bowls')]:
    config=f'configs/datagen/{name}.yaml' if phase=='baseline' else f'workspace/configs/datagen/{name}.yaml'
    # Scratch YAML retains all recipe settings except explicitly requested random starts.
    prepare=["docker","exec","s2r-sim","s2r-entrypoint","python","-c",
        "import yaml,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path("+repr(config)+"); d=yaml.safe_load(p.read_text()); d.pop('starts_dir',None); o=pathlib.Path('/workspace/s2r/outputs/v3-sim-checks/"+phase+"/"+name+"-random.yaml'); o.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); o.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(d,sort_keys=False)); print(o)"]
    result=subprocess.run(prepare,capture_output=True,text=True)
    Path('/tmp/v3-sim-checks/'+phase+'_'+name+'_recipe.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':prepare,'exit_code':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout+result.stderr},indent=2))
    config=(f'outputs/v3-sim-checks/{phase}/{name}-random.yaml' if name=='stack_bowls' else (f'configs/datagen/{name}.yaml' if phase=='baseline' else f'workspace/configs/datagen/{name}.yaml'))
    command=f'docker exec -e S2R_GIT_COMMIT={commit} -e S2R_ARM=so101 -e S2R_SCENE=rpd_meeting_room -e S2R_TASK={task} s2r-sim s2r-entrypoint python -m sim.datagen.scripted --config_path {config} --seed 101 --attempts 10 --episodes 2 --headless --destination /workspace/s2r/outputs/v3-sim-checks/{phase}/datasets/{name} --repo_id local/v3_sim_{name} --report /workspace/s2r/outputs/v3-sim-checks/{phase}/{name}-report.json'
    subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/v3-sim-checks/run.py',phase+'_datagen_'+name,command])

import argparse, importlib.util, json, os, runpy, traceback
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--task',required=True); p.add_argument('--variant',required=True); p.add_argument('--arm',default='so101'); p.add_argument('--phase',default='v3'); p.add_argument('--out',required=True)
a=p.parse_args()
os.environ.update(S2R_ARM=a.arm,S2R_SCENE='rpd_meeting_room',S2R_TASK=a.task)
helper=runpy.run_path('/workspace/s2r/tests/fixtures/v3_baseline/capture_sim_baseline.py')
result=dict(task=a.task,variant=a.variant,arm=a.arm,scene='rpd_meeting_room',steps_completed=0)
app=None; env=None
def save():
    target=Path(a.out); target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); target.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
try:
    if a.phase=='baseline':
        from sim.app import launch
    else:
        from sim import launch
    app=launch(selection=argparse.Namespace(arm=a.arm,scene='rpd_meeting_room',task=a.task,variant=a.variant),headless=True,enable_cameras=True,device='cuda:0')
    origin=importlib.util.find_spec('utils')
    result['utils_origin_after_kit']=None if origin is None else origin.origin
    print('UTILS_AFTER_KIT='+str(result['utils_origin_after_kit']),flush=True)
    import gymnasium as gym
    import torch
    from isaaclab_tasks.utils import parse_env_cfg
    if a.phase=='baseline':
        import sim.envs as registry
    else:
        import sim.workspace.envs as registry
    env_id=registry.TASK.gym_id(a.variant)
    result['gym_id']=env_id
    cfg=parse_env_cfg(env_id,device='cuda:0',num_envs=1)
    result['cfg']=helper['json_safe'](cfg.to_dict()); save()
    env=gym.make(env_id,cfg=cfg)
    env.reset(); result['reset_completed']=True
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for i in range(20):
            env.step(torch.zeros(env.action_space.shape,device=env.unwrapped.device))
            result['steps_completed']=i+1
    result['status']='PASS'
except BaseException:
    result['status']='FAIL'; result['error']=traceback.format_exc(); print(result['error'],flush=True)
finally:
    save()
    if env is not None:
        try: env.close()
        except BaseException: result['close_error']=traceback.format_exc(); save()
    if app is not None:
        import sys
        sys.stdout.flush(); sys.stderr.flush(); app.close(exit_code=0 if result.get('status')=='PASS' else 1)
